race.comment: THEATRICAL QUEEN (8) has shown talent in each of her 2 preps, and her recent spell would have done her the world of good. A wide gate is no help, but still include her in all combinations. ILOVEDIAMONDS (6) improved from a solid fresh effort at Sale to finish third at Tatura nearly 2 weeks ago. She will continue to improve with racing, and she can figure in the top 3 again. PRESTIGE HELLBENT (9) found the 1000m too sharp on debut, and battle on well enough to finish sixth. He gets a big swing in his draw here, strips fitter, and will be a quick improver. Each way value. PRIME FORCE (10) makes his debut, and the Moody/Coleman stable only trek their team here when they are confident of winning, so with that in mind, he will only need luck in the running to be a big threat to take this out. CELESTIAL HONOR (12) resumes from a spell and starts from a handy draw. Her jump-out form indicates that she will be ready to rumble fresh. Keep safe.
